tasks.title: Board: backups
tasks.statement: Build the protection of the virtual machines on the board: every VM needs a copy that survives the loss of the domain holding its disk. Five scenarios: snapshots that are not backups, the backup type per kind of disk, the VMs of a second domain, a forgotten VM and a new VM with neither a disk nor a backup. The exercise is solved when all scenarios are solved.
tasks.hint: A snapshot lives on the same domain as the disk and is lost with it. Only an incremental or a full backup survives. Incremental needs a qcow2 disk with change tracking; a raw disk is copied whole.

tasks.title: Board: disaster recovery
tasks.statement: Build disaster recovery between data centers on the board: the replica of a storage domain must live in another data center and be Active. Five scenarios: the first replica, a replica in a data center without hosts, two sites replicating into each other, a VM with disks on two domains and a copy that sits next to the original. The exercise is solved when all scenarios are solved.
tasks.hint: Only a replica in another data center survives the loss of a site, and only an Active one: a domain is Active when an Up host of its own data center sees it. Every domain that holds a VM disk needs a replica, and a replica has one primary.
